correctness.rationale: The punctured type-A minimal nilpotent cone is the nonzero cotangent bundle of projective space. For n>=3 its H^1 vanishes, H^2 is one-dimensional over C, and its fundamental group is trivial. Contractibility of the cone shifts these to first nonzero vertex local cohomology in degree 3. Xu's Proposition 3.3 gives S3 but not S4. Proposition 3.5 and simple connectivity force every S2 sheaf to be a direct sum of the constant sheaf, so no nonzero geometric MCM object survives. The argument includes all quantifiers and is independent of finite experimentation.

originality.rationale: The source paper covers the n=3 example only. Uniform minimal-orbit cohomology is classical, but no inspected source or published-finding search applies the newly introduced geometric Serre formalism to obtain exact depth three and zero constructible MCM category for all n>=4. The coherent-MCM literature on the same spaces is explicitly distinguished and does not cover the constructible category.

value.rationale: The family is canonical and infinite, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Exact geometric depth stays fixed at three while the real dimension grows as 4(n-1), and the complete nonzero geometric-MCM category disappears. The contrast with abundant coherent MCM sheaves on the same symplectic singularities exposes a structural difference between the newly defined constructible notion and the classical algebraic one.
